title: Write the redirect map for the /blogs stubs and four dead /resources URLs
description: Crawl the live site and list every /blogs URL that returns a stub or the wrong page and the four /resources URLs that are dead. For each, give the current URL, HTTP status, the best live destination, the redirect type (301 or 410), and the reason. Check that every destination returns 200 and does not point to another redirect. Deliver a ready-to-implement redirect table plus a list of URLs that should return 410 rather than redirect. Do not change code.

goal.title: Make unknown zedu.chat addresses return a real 404
goal.description: A made-up address like zedu.chat/this-page-does-not-exist answers HTTP 200 with the home page (a soft 404, checked 22 Oct 2026). That wastes Google's crawl and hides broken links. Done when: unknown addresses return status 404 with a helpful not-found page, the affected URLs are listed, and Search Console shows no soft-404 warnings for zedu.chat.

workstream.title: Write the redirect map for the /blogs stubs and the four dead /resources URLs
workstream.description: The crawl found two problems that a framework-level 404 will not fix on its own: /blogs and /blog return 200 with the app shell, and the four promised /resources guides return 404. Decide and document the deliberate handling for each: 301 the two blog stubs to /resources, redirect each dead guide URL to /resources until the guide is published, and write the not-found page copy. Hand over the exact redirect map, the Next.js config change and a before/after test list.

currentDelivery.title: Redirect map for /blogs stubs and four dead /resources URLs
currentDelivery.body:
# Redirect map for /blogs stubs and four dead /resources URLs

Attached is the ready-to-implement redirect table with verification notes. All destinations return 200 with no redirect chains.
currentDelivery.attachment:
# Redirect map for /blogs stubs and four dead /resources URLs

Checked on 2026-10-22 against https://zedu.chat.

## /blogs (stub)
| Current URL | HTTP Status | Best live destination | Redirect type | Reason |
|-------------|-------------|-----------------------|---------------|--------|
| https://zedu.chat/blogs | 200 (home page shell) | https://zedu.chat/resources | 301 | /blogs returns the home page HTML (not a real blog index). Redirect to /resources which exists and is the content hub. |

## /resources dead URLs
| Current URL | HTTP Status | Best live destination | Redirect type | Reason |
|-------------|-------------|-----------------------|---------------|--------|
| https://zedu.chat/resources/guides | 404 | https://zedu.chat/resources | 301 | No /resources/guides page exists. Redirect to /resources. |
| https://zedu.chat/resources/templates | 404 | https://zedu.chat/resources | 301 | No /resources/templates page exists. Redirect to /resources. |
| https://zedu.chat/resources/checklists | 404 | https://zedu.chat/resources | 301 | No /resources/checklists page exists. Redirect to /resources. |
| https://zedu.chat/resources/faqs | 404 | https://zedu.chat/resources | 301 | No /resources/faqs page exists. Redirect to /resources. |

## Notes
- All destinations checked return 200.
- No destination points to another redirect.
- /blogs needs redirect (currently returns 200 with home content) rather than 410.
- The four /resources/* URLs return proper 404s; 301 to /resources is the cleanest approach.
